notes.title: Graphics Improvements, Bug Fixes and a New Song
notes.notes:
Bringing Blockhead 2D back to you with another graphical improvement! I've decided to bring it back to old-school graphics in some respects and improve in different areas.  I also subtracted a painting, then added one to the living room.

The gym level also needed a goofy new song, so check it out in game to experience it!

Here's some sneak peaks of what to expect for visuals!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42596776/62d32d933790ca6e00f6b2dc0fd5011695d1f4d9.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42596776/7235d18a9251a031b0d0c3ee4e712ad137abdcdb.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42596776/5586e116657397e5e0644900d4245eb52d2663e6.png

If you want to see more, check out the game!

Total Update:

- Updated the graphics; Kept a few sprites and then added some extra tiles

- Fixed a bug where the aquarium water wouldn't move

- Added collisions to the stove and refrigerator in the kitchen for easier movement

- Fixed a bug where the guiding arrow for finding your opponent was hidden

notes.title: Necessary Tutorial Update
notes.notes:
I wanted to introduce some direction into the game, since a few of Blockhead 2D's mechanics weren't understandable. So, I made it so you must play through all 4 of the characters' tutorials in order to be able to play the rest of the game. Also, can you find old James and Jeb?

This has been updated for both the GameJolt and Steam versions! Enjoy it with here or on GameJolt!

GameJolt Version

notes.title: Patch: Enemy Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Hey all! Here's some changes I made to Blockhead 2D recently:


- Added NEW screenshots to the storepage.

- Adjusted Jack's CPU so he's more aggressive.

- CPU Z-Layer is adjusted to they can be seen properly underwater.

Have fun!

~Kyvati Studios

notes.title: Small Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
- Fixed the blur not being present in water (fishbowl, aquarium and bathtub)

- Jack will try to keep above the player as much as he can

Have fun!

-Kyvati Studios

notes.title: CPU Patch and Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Here's a new patch for Blockhead 2D!

Things fixed:

- Some CPU opponents weren't able to detect whether or not you were jumping, therefore continuously running into a wall.

- Added more randomness to the taunts in the singleplayer mode.

- Decreased Jill's jumping raycast, making her bounce less off of the players' head.

notes.title: Small Bug Fixes/AI Changes
notes.notes:
- Made it so the turkeys won't go near the walls of the level, like Santa Hanz. 

- Adjusted the collisions of the turkeys, so they don't hang by the head.

notes.title: Musical Update!
notes.notes:
Hi there!

Kyvati Studios is proud to present the musical update! From now on, you won't hear the same music for the Holiday minigames!

The Pumpkin Smash, Turkey Slaughter and Santa Hanz's minigame, all have their own themes and sounds!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42596776/4aeeb0ef45d2d3c0a891bff1e6b9ce7675b9f7a5.jpg

Bug fixes: 

*The cameras in the splitscreen modes are now all the same.

*Taunts in the special modes have been fixed, so now you can talk back to Hanz!

*Jeb's super move fixed.

*Fixed a bug where James couldn't burp.

*Lighting fixes: The Halloween mode is completely dark, but the TV and pumpkins have their own light to guide you around the level.

*Turkeys have enhanced AI script and will now completely disappear when you hit them, to avoid stacking.


Have fun and stay tuned for even more awesome updates!

-AesynthGrey

notes.title: Holiday Special Update!
notes.notes:
Happy Holidays!!!

Welcome, Santa Hanz, to our new Holiday minigame!

In this smashing mode, beat up Santa Hanz to get presents out of his bag, alone or with a friend!

He's hard to catch and likes to taunt as you try and hit him! Also, check out our new trailer!

[previewyoutube=7yQ7rxfFWUs;full][/previewyoutube]

Changelog: 

*Fixed a problem with the sprinting where you'd still be running even after you've let go of the button.

*UI Overhaul for all splitscreen modes.

*Multiple bug fixes.

notes.title: Progress on the new Christmas update!
notes.notes:
It's been awhile since I've posted anything, so here's some sneak peaks of the Christmas minigame for Blockhead 2D!

This is Santa Hanz: 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42596776/057bdca38d752a04adc3e9618a7ff5b533c2d911.png

You'll need to bounce on his head to get presents out of his bag! He's fast and likes to jump a lot, including on you! But he'll just hold you down; Hanz is too smol to hurt you. :)

What would Christmas be without a tree?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42596776/715468a6222c5629113fe59ac37885bc99fb07ca.png

Every present you don't smash after you hit Santa's bag, goes under this tree!

And of course, for this holiday decoration, an elf on the shelf! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42596776/048f0aee24751af5e585612d782a97aafc1c009d.png

PS: There will be a price increase to $4.99 after Steam's Winter Sale. Be sure to get it now at its low price before it goes up! 

Stay tuned.
-AesynthGrey

notes.title: November Update!
notes.notes:
The November update is here! Smash turkeys alone or with a friend in this new, smashing update!

In the single-player edition of this update, you will be smashing 10 turkeys as fast as you can, using the specials of each character to get to them faster. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42596776/78034cb06d9dbcb74cfb728a84752ef82b127a4d.jpg

However, in the 2-player splitscreen edition, both players with be competing and holding each other down, competing to smash just one, very difficult to catch, turkey.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42596776/4fffe293c41ae43bb7f0275b59b63599d8a0e5ba.jpg


Fixes include: 

*Jack couldn't be hurt in splitscreen

*NEW UI changes. There is now an icon for Jack and Jill's sprint.

Have a happy November and have a great time! :)

-AesynthGrey

notes.title: Small Game Update, New Library Hero, and more!

Also, I improved the design of the level by making the walls and ceiling even.
